About.info: The RS School React Course is a highly structured, community-driven online training program designed to take your frontend skills to an advanced level. Provided entirely free of charge by The Rolling Scopes School community, this course operates on a unique "Pay it forward" principle, where students learn from volunteer industry professionals and are later encouraged to return as mentors.
